svg.title: Make a little snow man — step 5: Meet your little snow man
svg.desc: Name your new friend and take a picture. Give it a snowball neighbour, a pine-cone hat or a different expression. Try a traditional snowman or an upside-down joke with a grown-up helping. Make each friend different, then head inside for a warm-up break.
